titles.title: Quake3-TeamArena - Play Quake III Arena.bat (ioquake3 1.36 + baseq3)
titles.engine: id Tech 3: ioquake3 1.36 (ioquake3.x86.exe, md5 12f99bc0f9ba416ee477a4f13de8feaa, 'ioq3 1.36 win_mingw-x86 Apr 12 2009'). It uses SDL 1.2's DirectX backend by default; every box logged 'SDL using driver "directx"'. It runs over id's 1.32 point-release paks pak0-pak8. Confirmed.
titles.launch_sets:
1920x1080 fullscreen, measured tonight on ALL FOUR LCD boxes. Evidence paths are relative to .claude/evidence-1080p/.
- .145: 145-q3/t1-ioq3-baseq3/timeline.txt (WINLIST SDL_app 1920x1080) and m1 qconsole.log ('...setting mode -1: 1920 1080').
- .123: q3-123/L1/condump-L1-menu.txt.
- .195 (Win7): q3-195/10-launch1-ioq3-baseq3.log and 13-launch1-condump.txt.
- .240: 240-q3/24-A-condump-mainmenu.txt.

Mechanism, as the survey said:
- FLEETRES.BAT runs FLEETRES.EXE -cmd, which reads the EDID and the driver mode list. It returns FR_W=1920 FR_H=1080 FR_FOV=106 FR_HZ=60 (captured in 145-q3/fleetres-cmd.txt, q3-123/01-fleetres-cmd.txt and 240-q3/box-cfg-before/temp-fleetres.cmd-OLD).
- The launcher writes baseq3\fleetres.cfg and passes the same +set values, except r_displayRefresh.
- The staged autoexec.cfg ends with 'exec fleetres.cfg'.
- GAMESYNC writes the same settings (agent/shared/gameres.h:685, gr_cfg_body kind NULL). Its line order differs, but gr_w_cfg compares per setting, so the two writers agree.
- FLEETGL keeps ioquake3, because FR_W>800.

CORRECTION: the survey's caveat that '.240 cannot get 1080p' is refuted. At 23:55 .240 read EDID DELL E2313H with 1920x1080@60 in its driver list (240-q3/00-gameres-before.json, 01b-gameres.json). Every launch there set mode -1 1920x1080. If .240's EDID read fails again, FLEETRES falls back to 1024x768; that would be a DDC or box fault, not a fault in this title.
titles.menu_source:
A hardcoded 12-entry table in baseq3/pak8.pk3 vm/ui.qvm (id 1.32 q3_ui, 2002-09-30): 320x240, 400x300, 512x384, 640x480, 800x600, 960x720, 1024x768, 1152x864, 1280x1024, 1600x1200, 2048x1536, and '856x480 wide screen'.

This QVM loads on every box today:
- 'Loading vm file vm/ui.qvm...' appears in the .123, .145, .195 and .240 logs.
- Read back at 00:56, all eight baseq3/missionpack q3config.cfg files on the LCD boxes have vm_ui "2".

Confirmed on hardware:
- Cycling Video Mode walks exactly those 12 entries and stops at 856x480 (q3-195/videomode-cycle/vm01-vm12 and vm-low1-3; 145-q3/m1-ioq3-baseq3-fullscreen-menu/videomode-list; 240-q3/30b).
- The label reads '640x480' in a 1920x1080 frame (q3-195/25-baseq3-system-graphics-menu.jpg).
- Any Apply writes r_mode 3, and the session drops to 640x480. '...setting mode 3: 640 480' was logged on .145 (m1 qconsole.log), .123 (q3-123/L1/condump-L1-after-accept.txt), .195 (q3-195/27-after-accept-condump.txt) and .240 (240-q3/74-D-condump-after-accept.txt).
- The next launch restores 1920x1080.

A driver-enumerated menu is already staged but unused: baseq3/uix86.dll, the ioq3 1.36 q3_ui, reads r_availableModes. ioquake3 publishes that cvar with 1920x1080 as the FIRST entry on all four LCD boxes (15-24 entries, well under the 31-entry cap).
titles.evidence:
STATIC
- Re-verified in the staged tree (case-insensitive):
  - r_availableModes is present in ioquake3.x86.exe and baseq3/uix86.dll.
  - It is absent from quake3.exe, missionpack/uix86.dll, pak8 ui.qvm (md5 3e6b8fad) and TA pak3 ui.qvm.
  - No vm_ui or sv_pure appears in any baseq3/missionpack cfg or bat. It appears only in README.txt:204 and in the unrelated instaunlagged/*.cfg.
  - stage-fleetres.py --check shows this title current. Its only failure is Thief2.
  - FLEETRES.EXE md5 bb180f3b is identical in the repo and on the share.
- My disassembly of ioquake3.x86.exe (capstone):
  - CL_SystemInfoChanged at 0x41ab0b-0x41ab36 does fistp [0xcaefb0] = (int)Cvar_VariableValue("sv_pure"). This is cl_connectedToPureServer.
  - CL_Disconnect at 0x41169b sets it to 0.
  - CL_InitUI at 0x41eccb reads it and forces the QVM when it is non-zero.
- On the share, no baseq3 UI replacement and no newer engine exists. Checked Games/Mods & Patches/Quake III, the Quake III (Complete) rar, tmp_install, _preserved-from-fleet, and Game Updates/Quake3e (no r_availableModes).

HARDWARE: native UI (other testers' evidence)
- .145 (XP, GeForce 8400GS): 145-q3/m2-ioq3-baseq3-nativeui-selfheal/qconsole.log shows 'Sys_LoadDll(C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena\baseq3\uix86.dll): succeeded', and after Apply '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080'. videomode-list/strip.png shows 1920x1080 first, then the driver list.
- .123 (Radeon HD 3850): q3-123/probe-vm_ui0/ shows the same.
- .195 (Win7, HD 5450): q3-195/61-launch4-condump.txt and 62-vmui0-ioq3-ui-graphics-menu.jpg show 'Video Mode: 1920x1080'. 64-vmui0-after-accept-condump.txt shows the mode kept.

HARDWARE: pure server
- 145-q3/m3 and q3-123/probe-vm_ui0/condump-probe-vm_ui0-connected.txt: after connecting to 192.168.1.132:27961 the FS restarts ('... on the pure list'), then 'Loading vm file vm/ui.qvm...'. The player stays in the game; there is no kick.

HARDWARE: my A/B on .145 (review-quake3-teamarena/box145-localgame/)
- Run A: vm_ui 0 plus a local '+map q3dm17' at the default sv_pure. After 'Server Initialization' the log shows 'Loading vm file vm/ui.qvm...'.
- Run B2: the same plus '+set sv_pure 0'. After the map load the log shows 'Loading dll file ui.' / uix86.dll succeeded.
- Both runs rendered fullscreen at 1920x1080 (A-*-screen.png, B2-*-screen.png).
titles.fix:
The survey's fix is confirmed, and it is now proven on hardware. The main-menu part was measured by the parallel testers on .123, .145 and .195; the local-game part was measured by me on .145 (runs A and B2).

The fix: add '+set vm_ui 0 +set sv_pure 0' to the ioquake3 start line only.
- baseq3/uix86.dll then lists r_availableModes and shows 1920x1080.
- Apply keeps r_mode -1 with 1920x1080.
- sv_pure 0 IS required. At the default sv_pure 1, a local game reloads the pak8 QVM (run A).

Implementation, as proposed:
- In FLEETGL.BAT, set FR_UIARGS at the top, beside FR_ENGINE=ioquake3.x86.exe, and clear it where FR_ENGINE=quake3.exe.
- Splice %FR_UIARGS% into Play Quake III Arena.bat through a stage-fleetres.py repair() pair: 'start "" %FR_ENGINE% +set r_mode -1' becomes 'start "" %FR_ENGINE% %FR_UIARGS% +set r_mode -1'. The old string is unique to this launcher, so the pair applies once.
- Never write the literal exe name; test_q3_voodoo2_gl.py rejects it.

ADDED by this review:
1. Also put '+set vm_ui 2' on Play Team Arena.bat's start line. vm_ui is CVAR_ARCHIVE, and ioquake3 writes q3config.cfg within seconds (measured on .145 at 00:54:39, even though the process was later killed). The Team Arena search path includes %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3 (q3-123/L2/condump-L2-menu.txt). So the first Team Arena launch on a profile with no missionpack q3config.cfg execs baseq3's file, inherits vm_ui 0, and loads the untested missionpack/uix86.dll.
2. FLEETGL.BAT exists only on the share. Extend tests/python/test_q3_voodoo2_gl.py to assert that FR_UIARGS is cleared in the quake3.exe branch.
3. scripts/benchmarks/lan_check.py IdTech3.launcher_args copies this start line 'verbatim'. Update it in the same change.
4. The native menu in fleet-server matches still needs sv_pure 0 in ~/q3a-server/.q3a/baseq3/server.cfg line 18. This is an operator decision; q3ta-server already runs sv_pure 0.

Alternative: the patched-QVM pk3 in the retail entry would also serve ioquake3 with no vm_ui/sv_pure flags. It would even survive sv_pure-1 local games.
titles.fix_risk:
Low. Measured on hardware: the DLL loads on XP with a GeForce 8400GS, XP with a Radeon HD 3850, and Win7 with a Radeon HD 5450. It survives Apply at 1920x1080, and the client joins the pure fleet server without a kick.

Remaining risks:
- (a) Pure servers. They force the pak8 QVM, Apply trap included. After disconnecting, that QVM stays loaded at the main menu until the next vid_restart or map load, because CL_Disconnect only clears the flag (0x41169b). So an Apply right after a pure match still writes r_mode 3 for that session. Joining a pure server also overwrites the client's sv_pure to 1 for the rest of the session, so later local games load the QVM again. (Both are code-derived.)
- (b) vm_ui 0 leaks into a first Team Arena launch unless Team Arena passes vm_ui 2.
- (c) The flags must never reach retail quake3.exe. It would show the MB_TOPMOST 'Security Warning' DLL dialog over the fullscreen game.
- (d) The native server browser/Favorites uses the same server1..16 cvars (both modules contain 'server%d'), but nobody has exercised it on a box yet.
- (e) lan_check drift.

The 31-entry cap is not a practical risk. SDL keeps the largest mode first, and 1920x1080 was entry #1 on all four LCD boxes.
titles.hw_check:
Before touching a box, PROCLIST/WINLIST it. Tonight all four LCD boxes were shared by several agents, and one of my runs collided with another agent's.

Boxes:
- .123, .145, .240 run XP; GDI SCREENSHOT captures fullscreen there.
- .195 runs Win7. Use F11 (screenshotJPEG) and DOWNLOAD from %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\screenshots.

Steps:
1. Launch: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena" "Play Quake III Arena.bat".
2. WINLIST must show SDL_app 'ioquake3' at 1920x1080.
3. Read state from a condump or qconsole.log, not by typing cvar names. UIKEY TEXT lost SHIFT under ioquake3: '_' arrived as '-' (']\r-mode' in the .123/.145/.240 logs). Launch with +set logfile 2, or exec an uploaded cfg whose name has only lowercase letters, then DOWNLOAD.
   Expect: 'Loading dll file ui.' / 'Sys_LoadDll(...baseq3\uix86.dll): succeeded'.
4. Go to main menu > SETUP > SYSTEM. The menu is keyboard-navigable in exclusive fullscreen on XP and Win7 (measured), so no windowed fallback is needed.
   - The Video Mode label must read 1920x1080.
   - RIGHT must walk the driver list.
5. Change Texture Filter and press ACCEPT. The log must show '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080' again.
6. Start a Skirmish, or +map q3dm17. After 'Server Initialization' the log must print 'Loading dll file ui.', not 'Loading vm file vm/ui.qvm' (measured on .145 run B2).
7. Connect to 192.168.1.132:27961. Expect vm/ui.qvm unless the server was changed to sv_pure 0.
8. Check that the Favorites tab shows the managed server1..16 entries.
9. Delete condumps and screenshots, and restore any test q3config.
titles.verifier_notes:
CONFIRMED WITH CHANGES.
1. launch_sets now cites hardware on all four LCD boxes, and the '.240 cannot' caveat is removed (refuted by the 240-q3 evidence).
2. The fix is no longer code-only:
   - The native UI on .123, .145 and .195 comes from the parallel testers' evidence.
   - I measured the local-game half on .145. Run A shows sv_pure 0 is necessary; run B2 shows it is sufficient.
   - I confirmed the pure-flag logic in the binary.
3. Added: the Team Arena vm_ui leak with the '+set vm_ui 2' mitigation, post-pure-match QVM persistence, lan_check drift, and a test assertion for the share-only FLEETGL.
4. hw_check: keys DO reach the fullscreen ioquake3 menu; typed underscores do not.

BOX HYGIENE: on .145 I restored %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\q3config.cfg and qconsole.log from review-quake3-teamarena/box145-before/ and verified both md5s. games.log is still 0 bytes, and the missionpack config is untouched. All four LCD boxes read vm_ui "2" at 00:56.

COLLISION: my first run B at 00:52:45 overlapped ue-review's UT 469e launch on .145. Its 'GLimp_Init() - could not load OpenGL subsystem' dialog appears in ue-review/145-ut469e-getres/00-after-launch.png. That agent's tilde/getres/Enter sequence may have typed into my dialog, so that capture should be re-run. Run B2 at 00:54, on an idle box, replaced run B.

SIDE FINDING (favourites job):
- favorites.py q3_favorites (line 107) writes internet hostnames into '// ' comments and strips only \n. masters.py:127 strips only ^colour codes.
- The 1.32 and 1.36 Cbuf_Execute split on ';' and \r BEFORE comments are dropped. Proof: the staged autoexec.cfg's own line 4 ('...rewritten on exit; this is not.') prints 'Unknown command "this"' in the ioquake3 condumps on .123, .195 and .240.
- A hostname containing ';' or \r would therefore run console commands on every box at every launch.
- Fix: sanitise the labels (drop ';', \r and '"'), and reword autoexec line 4.

titles.title: Quake3-TeamArena - Play Team Arena.bat (ioquake3 1.36 + fs_game missionpack)
titles.engine: id Tech 3: ioquake3 1.36 with fs_game missionpack. The script-driven Team Arena UI comes from missionpack/pak3.pk3 vm/ui.qvm (TA 1.32) at vm_ui 2, and its menus from missionpack/pak0.pk3. Confirmed.
titles.launch_sets:
1920x1080 fullscreen, measured on:
- .145: 145-q3/t2, m4 and m5 logs ('...setting mode -1: 1920 1080').
- .123: q3-123/L2 condumps.
- .195: q3-195/40-launch2-ta.log (WINLIST SDL_app 1920x1080) and 41-launch2-ta-condump.txt.
- .240: B phase.

Same chain as the baseq3 shortcut:
- The launcher writes missionpack\fleetres.cfg and passes identical +set values plus +set fs_game missionpack.
- missionpack\autoexec.cfg is staged byte-identical to baseq3's; on the boxes it carries no favourites block. It execs fleetres.cfg.
- GAMESYNC writes missionpack\fleetres.cfg (gameres.h:686).

Confirmed.
titles.menu_source:
A hardcoded cvarFloatList for r_mode in missionpack/pak0.pk3:
- ui/system.menu: main menu > Setup > System, labels written with '*' (e.g. 640*480).
- ui/ingame_system.menu: ESC > System, labels written with 'x' (e.g. 640x480).
pak1-3 do not replace these files (re-listed). Neither Team Arena UI module reads r_availableModes: not the pak3 QVM, and not missionpack/uix86.dll.

Confirmed on hardware:
- The label is BLANK at r_mode -1 while the game renders 1920x1080: 145-q3/m5-ioq3-teamarena-ingame-system/05-system.png and focus-walk/contact.png; 240-q3/51-B; q3-195/ta-nav/w10-w11-compare.png (left).
- One click sets r_mode 1, which is 400x300 (400*300 in the main menu), and Quality flips to Custom: 240-q3/52-B with 54-B-condump-rmode.txt; w10-w11-compare right; the .123 L2 condump shows r_mode "1".
- Apply is vid_restart only. r_mode -1 survives it: '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080' after Apply on .123 (L2) and .145 (m5 qconsole.log).
- Quality presets (ui_glCustom 0-3) write r_mode 4 or 3 according to the source. Not exercised; .145 currently shows 'High Quality'.
titles.evidence:
- Menu extracts and pak provenance: static-quake3-teamarena/teamarena-menus.txt. I re-listed the paks: pak0 holds system.menu, ingame_system.menu and ingame.txt; pak3 holds only menus.txt and ui.qvm.
- My disassembly of missionpack/pak3.pk3 vm/ui.qvm (md5 59cb82218d1d32472851380488501feb):
  - Exactly one function references 'expected float but found' (PC_Float_Parse, at QVM instruction 39573).
  - It tests token.string[0] with LOCAL/LOAD1/SEX8/CONST 45/NE, and it contains a NEGF.
  - So a '-1' in a cvarFloatList parses to -1.0 in the staged 1.32 QVM. The stock missionpack ui/min_hud.menu already carries 'rect 39 -14 40 32'.
- showCvar/hideCvar/cvarTest:
  - The pak3 QVM contains these strings.
  - missionpack/uix86.dll exports ItemParse_cvarTest, ItemParse_showCvar and ItemParse_hideCvar (objdump).
- The Team Arena search path puts the homepath missionpack DIRECTORY before the basepath pk3s (q3-123/L2/condump-L2-menu.txt).
- q3ta-server re-read: server.cfg line 4 is 'set sv_pure 0'; the unit is active.
titles.fix:
The survey's data-only fix is confirmed as the right one, and I found nothing that refutes it. It is not yet tested on a box.

The fix: add missionpack/zz-fleetres-menus.pk3. The name sorts after pak3, so it has the highest priority, and it contains no parentheses. It holds edited copies of pak0's ui/system.menu and ui/ingame_system.menu, whose Video Mode cvarFloatList gains an r_mode -1 entry. There are two variants:
- Two items at the same rect: 'cvarTest r_customheight showCvar {"1080"}' labelled 1920x1080 (1920*1080 in system.menu), and a hideCvar twin labelled Custom. A hidden item cannot take focus (Item_SetFocus).
- The minimal variant: a single "Custom" -1 entry.

Why it works:
- The staged QVM parses -1 (bytecode above). MAX_MULTI_CVARS is 32; the list would have 13 entries.
- It survives Apply, because Apply is vid_restart only.
- It shows at the main menu, and in matches on q3ta-server (sv_pure 0).
- On a pure Team Arena server the pk3 is not on the list, so the stock menus appear, with no kick. .menu reads never set FS_GENERAL_REF, and the FS restarts on connect anyway.

ADDED: GAMESYNC never deletes, so withdrawing the pk3 later needs a delete line in the launcher.
titles.fix_source: The fix is built from files already in the tree. Extract ui/system.menu and ui/ingame_system.menu from /mnt/retro-share/Files/Games-Library/Quake3-TeamArena/missionpack/pak0.pk3, edit them, and zip them. Write through gvfs and verify each file through /mnt. Nothing needs downloading.
titles.fix_risk:
Low. The change is data only and touches two menus.
- An unbalanced brace would break the whole menu set. Test on one box before pushing to the fleet.
- Quality presets still move r_mode to 800x600 or 640x480, as they do today.
- There is no multiplayer or pure-server consequence.
- The fix has not been run on hardware yet.
titles.hw_check:
1. Launch: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena" "Play Team Arena.bat".
2. Confirm 1920x1080 fullscreen: WINLIST shows the SDL_app at 1920x1080 on XP; on .195 use F11 and DOWNLOAD from %APPDATA%\Quake3\missionpack\screenshots.
3. The LABEL check is keyboard-automatable. In game, ESC > System; DOWN walks focus Graphics > Quality > GL Extensions > Video Mode (measured on .145, focus-walk). Today the label is blank; after the fix it must read 1920x1080.
4. CORRECTION to the survey: cycling and clicking ARE automatable.
   - With the shortcut's default DirectInput mouse, an absolute UICLICK does not move the Team Arena cursor (240-q3/44a), but a relative mouse_event does (44b).
   - Alternatively, relaunch once with '+set in_mouse -1' (SDL windib backend). Absolute UICLICK then works (.195 hovered and clicked Video Mode, ta-nav/w10-w11).
   - ENTER on a keyboard-focused multi item does nothing unless the cursor is inside it.
   - Use this only as a tool, then confirm the label fullscreen through the normal launch.
5. After Apply, the log must show '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080'.
6. Repeat in a match on 192.168.1.132:27962.
7. Delete the test pk3 and screenshots afterwards.
titles.verifier_notes:
CONFIRMED. Every claim about current behaviour is now hardware-backed on .123, .145, .195 and .240, from the parallel testers' evidence. I verified negative-float parsing in the staged QVM bytecode instead of relying on web source. CHANGED: hw_check, because automation is possible.

Favourites side-finding, refined. The survey found that favorites.py TITLES accepts no 'missionpack' gamename. Beyond that:
- Neither Team Arena UI module contains 'server%d' at all.
- They keep favourites in the engine's list (AddFavorite/CreateFavorite scripts), stored in %APPDATA%\Quake3\servercache.dat, which both mods share.
- That file holds 0 favourites on .123, .195 and .240, and .195's Team Arena Favorites tab is empty (q3-195/45-ta-favorites.jpg).
- So no cfg writer can fill it, even after a TITLES change. It needs a servercache.dat writer (a binary, engine-version-specific layout), or it stays manual.

titles.title: Quake3-TeamArena - Play Quake III Arena - retail 1.32c.bat (id quake3.exe 1.32c + baseq3)
titles.engine: id Tech 3: retail id quake3.exe 'Q3 1.32c win-x86' (md5 b5cf3dd55e045aac6096ff97379d0cab, re-verified; byte-identical to Files/Game Updates/quake3-1.32c-win.zip) over baseq3 pak0-pak8. Confirmed.
titles.launch_sets:
1920x1080 fullscreen through the same FLEETRES chain. The launcher writes baseq3\fleetres.cfg and runs 'start "" quake3.exe +set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% ...'. Measured:
- .145: 145-q3/t3-retail-132c/qconsole.log shows '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080 FS' and 'MODE: -1, 1920 x 1080 fullscreen hz:60'; WINLIST shows 'Quake 3: Arena' at 1920x1080.
- .123: q3-123/L3.
- .240: 240-q3/63-C.
- .195: q3-195/51-launch3-retail.log and 52 condump.

Confirmed.
titles.menu_source:
The same hardcoded table in baseq3/pak8.pk3 vm/ui.qvm (320x240 .. 2048x1536, plus '856x480 wide screen').
- quake3.exe publishes no r_availableModes (0 hits, case-insensitive).
- Every retail log shows 'Loading vm file vm/ui.qvm.'.
- On hardware: q3-195/55-retail-ingame-system-menu.jpg shows 'Video Mode: 640x480' in a 1920x1080 frame.
- Any Apply writes r_mode 3 (same QVM). That was demonstrated on ioquake3 on all four boxes; it was not repeated with the retail exe.
titles.evidence:
Binary:
- quake3.exe strings: 'Q3 1.32c'; 'Security Warning' with com_blindlyLoadDLLs; '%s has bad header'; 'Mode 11: 856x480 (wide)'; r_customwidth and r_customaspect; no r_availableModes.
- Disassembly: VM_Init at 0x439c10 defaults vm_ui to "2". CL_InitUI at 0x4110e0: pure gives 2, otherwise vm_ui.

Hardware: the paths above, plus 145-q3/m8-retail-132c-accept-test.
- Retail accepts synthetic keys in exclusive fullscreen: console commands typed on .240 (63-C, 66-C: ']/connect 192.168.1.132:27961', ']/gfxinfo') and on .123 (L3).

Share: nothing suitable, re-searched case-insensitively.
- Quake3e (Game Updates/Quake3e/quake3e.exe = Game Updates/quake3e.exe, md5 f177c5d4...) has no r_availableModes.
- The mods under Mods & Patches/Quake III are separate fs_game directories.

The 'Launch Quake3e.bat' named in SERVERS-online.txt:29 does not exist (case-insensitive find).
titles.fix:
Confirmed: there is no config-only route.
- vm_ui 0 brings up the Security Warning dialog and then an ioq3 DLL with no mode list, so it gains nothing.
- The real fix is a patched q3_ui QVM, assembled with q3asm -vq3 so it keeps VM_MAGIC 0x12721444. A VER2 QVM is ERR_FATAL 'has bad header' on retail. Ship it as baseq3/zz-fleetres-ui.pk3.
- The honest alternative is to accept launcher-only 1080p for this A/B shortcut.

Review additions:
(a) 'No kick on a pure server' holds. The client restarts its filesystem on connect: 'Current search path ... on the pure list' is logged right after connecting on .123 and .145. That clears pk3 references, and the zz pk3 is not on the server's list, so the client falls back to pak8's UI.
(b) Unlike the native DLL, a QVM pk3 also survives sv_pure-1 LOCAL games, because a local server's pure list contains every loaded pk3. For ioquake3 that would make the vm_ui/sv_pure flags unnecessary: one mechanism for both engines.
(c) For the patched menu inside fleet-server matches:
   - Either put the pk3 on quake3-server too. Every fleet box receives it through GAMESYNC, and the server already has sv_allowDownload 1; outside clients need cl_allowDownload 1.
   - Or set sv_pure 0 on the server.
titles.fix_source: Needs downloading: the GPL Quake III source (github.com/id-Software/Quake-III-Arena, whose code/q3_ui is id 1.32b and matches pak8, or ioquake3's) plus q3lcc/q3cpp/q3rcc/q3asm built on the dev host. None of these tools or sources exist on the host (checked PATH and ~/ to depth 5), and nothing suitable is on the share.
titles.fix_risk:
Moderate.
- The pk3 replaces the whole baseq3 UI module for both engines: menus, the server browser with Favorites (server1..16), and the CD-key menu. Base it on id 1.32b to minimise drift.
- Assembling without -vq3 stops quake3.exe starting at all, including on FLEETGL's Voodoo path.
- GAMESYNC never deletes, so a withdrawal needs a launcher delete step.
- Putting the pk3 on the pure server makes it mandatory for every client.
